description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableDefinitionIdentifier' which implements 'DefinitionIdentifier'. It provides methods for creating, parsing, and representing identifier objects with namespace, name, and version components. The class includes pattern matching for parsing string representations of identifiers and overrides standard methods such as equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ImmutableDefinitionIdentifier
classes.description: An immutable implementation of DefinitionIdentifier that encapsulates namespace, name, and version, and provides methods for creation, parsing, and string representation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of ImmutableDefinitionIdentifier with specified namespace, name, and version.

methods.name: ofParsed
methods.description: Parses a string representation of an identifier and returns an ImmutableDefinitionIdentifier instance.
